headline.zh-CN: 首页按个人专辑范围筛选
headline.en: Personal album scopes on the dashboard

summary.zh-CN: 首页新增全部、我主催、我参与筛选，统一查看相关专辑、曲目和待办。
summary.en: Filter the dashboard by all, managed or participating albums to focus its tracks, tasks and summaries.

description.zh-CN: 统计、待办、关注项、最近更新和列表随专辑范围一起更新，并可结合搜索、状态及固定专辑筛选。管理员全局权限不计入个人主催或参与关系。
description.en: Statistics, tasks, attention panels, recent updates and lists follow the selected album scope alongside search, status and pinned-album filters. Global administrator access does not count as a personal relationship.

description.zh-CN: 按账号在当前浏览器保存，首次默认全部，与专辑管理页互不影响。
description.en: The selection is saved per account in this browser, defaults to All and is independent of Album Management.
